title: MNCS Badge Sidecar
description: Deterministic machine-readable projection of an MNCS aggregate verdict (mncs.badge/1). The badge is presentation only: it binds to evidence by digest and revision identifiers but is never evidence itself. Only schema_version, label, and verdict are required; everything else is an optional binding. No timestamps: the document is a pure function of its inputs so identical inputs yield byte-identical output.

subject.description: What was verified: caller repository and subject commit. Carried verbatim; mncs-actions asserts nothing about them.

evidence.description: Bindings from the badge back to the aggregate evidence (digests) and declared boundary name.

revisions.description: Which mncs-actions revisions produced the underlying evidence: the executing implementation revision and, when asserted by the caller, the workflow carrier revision. Transport annotations only; no policy authority.
